title: MCP AuthScan labeled dataset: ground-truth OAuth authorization-server configurations for MCP scanner accuracy
description: A ground-truth dataset of Model Context Protocol (MCP) OAuth authorization-server configurations with known-correct probe verdicts, used to measure the accuracy of the mcp-authscan security scanner. Each configuration is a local fixture with one flaw (or a known combination) switched on, labeled before the scanner runs: plain PKCE acceptance, prefix redirect matching, symmetric/absent JWKS keys, permissive token-endpoint CORS, refused dynamic registration, and masking/unmasking interactions. Version 1 (mcp-authscan 1.1.47): 33 cases, 462 recorded probe rows, 176 of 176 labeled verdicts correct. Every run ships rows.jsonl, a provenance summary, and SHA-256 checksums. The dataset measures the scanner's own accuracy against local fixtures only; it imitates flaw classes and does not contain any third-party vulnerability. Provenance: github.com/LHMisme420/mcp-authscan at commit 8f3f2a770c0f8de9057856d97931fe013c02968e.
